title: Before you start

sections.heading: What this is
paragraphs: Feeltriva asks about your symptoms, tells you what it understood, and suggests what you could do next. It does not give a diagnosis and it is not a doctor.
If you think you may be seriously ill or in danger, do not wait for this check: contact a doctor or your local emergency service now.

sections.heading: Who it is for
paragraphs: Adults aged 18 or over, in India, answering about themselves.

sections.heading: What we keep, and for how long
paragraphs: We keep what you write, the answers you give, the age and other details you choose to tell us, and the result shown to you.
We keep a conversation for 30 days and then delete it. You can delete it yourself at any time before that.

sections.heading: Taking back your agreement
paragraphs: You can take back your agreement at any time by deleting the conversation. It is then removed and cannot be opened again.

acknowledgement: I have read this and agree to use Feeltriva on these terms.

training.label: You may also use my conversation to improve Feeltriva.
training.explanation: This is a separate choice. It is off unless you tick it, you can use Feeltriva without it, and it changes nothing about the check you get.
